name: stance-retreat-repair
description: retreat when damaged, to a place of repair: three tanks with retreat at 50% are hurt to about 35%; they go to the war factory, come back to full health and go back to where they were. The repair building (AmericaWarFactory) is an assumption: if the trace says "goes to the rally point", the faction repairs elsewhere; change the template. (Needs the commits with MSG_ASSIST_BASE_DEFEND / MSG_ASSIST_STANCE; until then "this build has no command".)
log: ^ASSIST stance retreat: unit \d+ at \d+% goes to repair facility
^ASSIST stance retreat: unit \d+ goes back to
